en.Esse lago matou mil e setecentas pessoas: This lake killed one thousand seven hundred people... and it's still hiding gas at the bottom! And the fix is bizarre.
en.Segue pra mais lugar mortal: o gás sobe: Follow for more deadly places: the gas rises from magma and gets trapped in the deep water, like a sealed soda bottle.
en.Na noite da tragédia, a água do fundo su: On the night of the disaster, the deep water shot up all at once, and the lake turned red, because of the iron.
en.A solução: desde 2001, canos puxam a águ: The fix: since two thousand one, pipes pull up the deep water and the gas escapes slowly, in a giant fountain.
